To ensure your existing users' data is not "ruined" by the new mandatory folder rule, the best approach is **Automatic Migration**.

When the app loads, it will detect if there are any "orphan" categories (top-level categories that do not have a folder). If found, it will automatically:
1.  Create a "General" folder (if one doesn't exist).
2.  Move those orphan categories into the "General" folder.
3.  Save this structure.

This ensures that from the user's perspective, their list is perfectly preserved—it's just neatly tucked inside a "General" folder now, fully compliant with your new rules.
